Former Big Brother Naija housemate, Dorathy Bachor, has taken the first step towards breast reduction surgery, three years after she first considered it. The reality TV star disclosed this in a post on her X handle on Wednesday. Dorathy said she had attended a consultation for the procedure, a decision she admitted she had long struggled to make. She wrote, “Finally got that breast reduction consultation. After three years of procrastinating, I’m finally facing my fears. “Looking ahead to 2027. New year, new me.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. I should have ignored noise in Big Brother house – Sheba Beauty brand signs Mercy Eke as ambassador I’ll spoil my parents with BBNaija prize money — Winner, Nkem She had earlier spoken about the challenges of finding well-fitting bras. In 2021, following the launch of her lingerie brand, My Full Chest, she said the difficulty of getting her own size inspired the business. She said, “It is hard to find my bra size, so I mean it is a struggle to find my size and I know how hard it is when I finally find one that is my size. “I know how much I have to pay for it if I am going to buy, I buy like two pairs and then that’s it, so I am doing this from that point of view. “I understand what it is so yeah, it is more like giving the people what they want and still running a business.” Adetutu Sobowale Adetutu has three years experience in publishing stories on gender, health, education, metro and fact-checking.
